title: Six Certified Branch Exclusions for the Ternary Covering Problem K_3(6,2)
description: Technical report, exact certificate data, and independent verification software for six normalized branch exclusions in the unresolved ternary covering-code problem K_3(6,2). Elementary sphere arguments reduce the normalized size-at-most-16 search to 38 third-center branches. Exact residual set-cover dual certificates exclude five weight-5 branches and one weight-6 branch. Independent Python and C++20 implementations verify every certificate over all 729 ambient words and every admissible center. The normalized frontier is reduced to 32 unresolved branches. The global interval 15 <= K_3(6,2) <= 17 remains unchanged. Version 0.1.1 is an archival and documentation patch adding an explicit compiled report PDF, a deterministic source bundle, and a checksum manifest. The theorem, proof, certificates, data, and computations are unchanged.
